analysis.purpose: Test harness helper that spawns the built crib CLI as a subprocess with given args inside a workspace fixture repo, captures stdout/stderr, strips Node's experimental-warning noise via the nested stripNoise helper, and returns a normalized {status, stdout, stderr} result for assertions.
responsibilities: Spawn `node <CLI> ...args` synchronously with cwd set to the workspace fixture root
Capture status/stdout/stderr with a 32MB output buffer cap
Strip noise lines from both stdout and stderr via stripNoise
Default status to 1 (failure) when spawnSync doesn't report one

businessRules.rule: status defaults to 1 (failure) when spawnSync's status is missing

invariants: Returned stdout/stderr never contain ExperimentalWarning/trace-warnings lines
preconditions: wsRepo test fixture directory already exists (e.g. built by wsPkg)
inputs: args: string[] — CLI arguments to pass to the subprocess
sideEffects: Spawns a child process synchronously (blocking) for the duration of the CLI run
errorBehavior: spawnSync failures don't throw here — status falls back to 1 and stdout/stderr are still returned, possibly empty
risks: maxBuffer is capped at 32MB — a runaway CLI process producing more output would be truncated or fail at the Node child_process layer, a mode not surfaced by this helper's return shape
whatToDistrust: 6 of 8 recorded call sites unresolved (spawnSync/trim/join/filter/split/test) — these are Node/lib built-ins, not a coverage gap

nodes.name: CLI subprocess test harness
nodes.summary: Runs the built crib CLI as a real subprocess against a scratch workspace fixture and normalizes its output for assertions.

edges.rationale: runWs is the harness entry point.
runWs calls its nested stripNoise helper to clean captured output before returning.

evidence.why: spawnSync call L288-292; stripNoise invocations L301-302; return shape L299-303
